claim_boundary: C019 registers twenty-four attacks. No current-cycle attack is decisive and no terminal result is claimed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the connector may constrain original Tseitin variables
attacks.method: Exhaust all endpoint values and set both fresh bridge variables true; every bridge clause is satisfied.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the added clauses may fail to join the two primal components
attacks.method: Build the full primal graph and verify one connected component after the endpoint-z-w-endpoint path is added.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a bounded-radius ball may simultaneously see a bridge and a charge
attacks.method: Place bridge endpoints at a torus coordinate whose distance from every charge exceeds 2R+4 and verify the bound for radii zero through four.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: connecting the components may invalidate the inherited lower bound
attacks.method: Check every original primal edge remains; treewidth is monotone under taking subgraphs, so one original toroidal line graph still yields m-1.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a listed positive formula may be rejected
attacks.method: OR one equality test per distinct listed encoding and replay all list members.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the cover may accept an unlisted unsatisfiable formula
attacks.method: The circuit accepts exactly hardwired listed strings; because every listed string is promised satisfiable, every accepted string is SAT.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: L-bit equality may require superlinear gates
attacks.method: Use literal selectors, an AND tree per word, and one OR tree; record the loose basis-safe upper bound 3mL.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the derived list-size threshold may be arithmetically wrong
attacks.method: From 3mL greater than L^k derive m greater than L^(k-1)/3 and test finite arithmetic fixtures.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a compiler may branch on the two input components
attacks.method: Replace H121 by the connected H125 formula while preserving the logical lobe distinction.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: connectedness and low output width may still not force a common quotient
attacks.method: Search for a proof from bounded ancestry and width alone; no such theorem is obtained.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: recovery metadata may encode which lobe contains each charge
attacks.method: Require every annotation in the factorization conclusion; no universal exclusion theorem is available.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a fixed-pass low-treewidth output may preserve lobe parity through a clever distributed gadget
attacks.method: Attempt an explicit construction; fixed ancestry blocks direct aggregation, but impossibility remains unproved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: its local equality may be dismissed as a two-component artifact
attacks.method: Add the H125 neutral bridge and preserve exact semantics, local separation, and width.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the line-graph transfer may cease to apply after bridge clauses are added
attacks.method: Use the original toroidal line graph as a subgraph of the bridged primal graph rather than claim full line-graph equality.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: its quotient obstruction may rely on visibly disconnected inputs
attacks.method: Create H127 on connected H125; the factorization theorem remains unresolved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: witness diversity may obscure a smaller circuit that simply recognizes every listed formula
attacks.method: Construct the H126 SAT-sound exact-membership circuit of size at most 3mL.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: its witness cover may not be the strongest universal positive-list upper bound
attacks.method: H126 covers the exact formula list without using witnesses; compare the two bounds and retain the smaller circuit for each list.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: known local twins may be either disconnected or already low width
attacks.method: Present H125, which is connected and retains Omega(sqrt(N)) primal treewidth.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the proposed lift obstruction may lack a connected concrete family
attacks.method: Use H125 as the explicit target; only the factorization half remains open.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: opposite-label local twins may require disconnected assemblies
attacks.method: H125 connects the two toroidal lobes with an identical neutral gadget outside every charge neighborhood.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a proof may count witnesses but not the exact list-membership circuit
attacks.method: Import H126 as an unavoidable SAT-sound circuit and charge distinct formula count in actual input length L.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a decoded positive set may be covered by exact membership before forcing a circuit error
attacks.method: Require any range-avoidance descendant to exceed the H126 cover budget and still provide SAT witnesses.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the connected Tseitin family may be misrepresented as hard equivalent-circuit endpoints
attacks.method: Record that C019 concerns satisfiability locality, not equivalent-circuit rewrite distance.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: new bridge gadgets might evade the fixed-gadget Circuit-Frege upper bound
attacks.method: No H110 endpoint is constructed; H117 remains unchanged and blocks transparent equivalence amplification.
